summary: Iteration 5: Verified USERNAME-BASED user login + P0 grid auto-scale. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_username_auth.py — owner/admin login via email, user login via username, wrong-pw error text differentiation (email vs username), old {email:} payload rejected (422), admin POST /admin/members with {name,username,password}, duplicate username 409, invalid-char rejection (422), immediate login by newly-created user, plan-shape (A=10 PTT, B=15 PTT, C=25 always-muted). Frontend: all UI flows work — LoginPage identifier field is type='text' with correct data-testid, owner→/platform, admin→/admin, user (alice.ops)→/room?id=..., admin dashboard shows usernames + member count '2/10' (dynamic per plan A cap 10), Add-member modal has member-username-input + no email input, room grid renders with dynamic gridTemplateColumns, no vertical scroll, recent-speakers-trigger + panel work, PTT bar (room-ptt-button) visible without scroll, owner plan cards render '10 push-to-talk users', '15 push-to-talk users', '25 always-muted users'.

ui_bugs.issue: planCardPrefix, ownerPlansSection, ownerStatMRR, planSelect, roomPlanSelectPrefix constants were MISSING from testIds.js — OwnerDashboard rendered data-testid='undefinedA/B/C' etc. Fixed by adding the missing constants.

action_items: None required — testIds.js constants were added by testing agent. Main agent may wish to audit for other missing TID constants (e.g., verify all TID.* used in components are defined).
critical_code_review_comments: testIds.js was missing multiple constants referenced by OwnerDashboard.jsx (planCardPrefix, ownerPlansSection, ownerStatMRR, planSelect, roomPlanSelectPrefix). JS silently returns `undefined` on missing keys → data-testid became 'undefinedA'. Consider a lint rule or a strict typed map (TS) to catch these.
